name: 98Token
fix_description: Remove the unlimited allowance (type(uint256).max) from Main contract to router, or add access control to swapTokensForTokens so only authorized callers can trigger swaps using the contract held tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-step exploit against an unprotected public function: the attacker directly calls the victim swap contract with crafted calldata to swap out its token balance to themselves. It requires minimal protocol-specific knowledge, no flash loans or complex state manipulation, and the PoC is very short and straightforward.
